about: Expected outcomes for authorization references (RFC 0001: D6, D14; document 04, 'Host-recorded approvals'). 'structural' is what scripts/operational_records.py reports (checked by its --self-test); nothing structural ever grants authority. 'runtime' is implemented by skills/agent-handoff/scripts/authorization.py and checked by its --self-test, which reads a generated copy of this file. Each case's 'action' is the operation being authorized; entries list the 'actions' they cover. A case may set 'policy' (null: no canonical policy) instead of 'trusted_policy'; a policy may carry owner_account_ids and authorization_files as the trust policy loader produces them.
